title: Version 1.56.0
body:
Version 1.56.0

May 27th, 2024

Added:

  • Fallen stars now show up at night! There is a rare chance every night (1 in 5) for a star rain, leading to more stars than usual. They are able to be used in schematics, as a building material, or sold for a low value
  • A new vinyl has been added: Brittle Rille. Good luck finding it!

Changes:

  • Items can now have their ownership cleared in their inspect menu, this requires the owner of the item to do so
  • Hovering over unfilled schematics now shows their name and progress!
  • Improved the performance of the game's atmospheric lighting system
  • Adjusted the collision box for the chocolate bunny from the easter event
  • Buffed the Petalfall Katana's swing power (0.5 -> 0.7), and made it's power (1 -> 2), allowing it to chop any resource
  • Unfilled schematics no longer have transparency, and now have their grid material turned off. The grid material can be re-enabled in the in-game settings!
  • Gifts that are anchored by the anchor wand can no longer be unboxed
  • Small misc. changes to the Statistic Tool
  • Opening a schematic you already own will now prompt you with a message informing you of such
  • Removed the ability to stack items into a vehicle with alignment conveyors and storage drawers due to player's abusing this bug to grief

Fixes:

  • Resolved an issue where items couldn't be transferred due to permissions being reset on leave
  • Fixed being able to anchor items on player's properties and have them stay on leave
  • Fixed a giant hole leading to part of the Petalfall quest
  • Fixed saws being able to saw trees even though they said it required a better tool
  • Fixed the Emberbane and Petalfall not showing their stats when inspecting
  • Fixed one of the meteor impacts being in the wrong spot, and moved it to a location in the desert

Version 1.56.1

May 30th, 2024

Changes:

  • Fully migrated our backend system to new, more reliable systems
  • Shutdown prompts now can have a reason provided, allowing us to provide info to end-users!
  • Smaller Lumite can now be sold

Fixed:

  • Patched a very minor duplication method for a specific resource
